searchText: The problem isn't that something is being done that can't otherwise be done. It is that contracts already exist that do this. As to why they did it originally, it was for gas saving I believe: https://github.com/Revest-Finance/RevestContracts/blob/master/hardhat/contracts/RevestSmartWallet.sol#L29-L37
